scope: Candidate THS3491DDA amplifier driven by the unchanged Logic RF Driver circuit; no PA implemented in KiCad

conditions.LPF_type: Butterworth L-C-L-C-L; capacitor-first input sensitivity C-L-C-L-C

limitations: Representative separately selected filters, not measured or component-selected filter boards.
U1 is the retained nominal IBIS-derived behavioral surrogate; output pulse currents and full supply current are unqualified.
TI THS3491 model is nominal at 25 C and +/-15 V; no temperature-dependent device model or thermal feedback.
Vendor negative-rail load-current source sign is corrected explicitly; RF transfer is checked against original model.
Macro-model harmonic distortion is not specified as accurate; displayed harmonics are diagnostic.
No extracted PCB, connector, supply impedance, converter circuit, mismatch sweep, or process-corner model.
Datasheet maximum-linear-output envelope remains an independent constraint; a converged SPICE run does not override it.
3.3 V rail number covers LED branches only; U1 VCCA dynamic current and actual clock-source current are not simulated.
